owner.title: Co-owner confirmation
owner.intro: {{applicant}} has submitted a registration that requires every co-owner's signature before it can be sent to the back office.
owner.consent: By approving you confirm that you are a co-owner of the vehicle in this registration.
owner.sentBody: All co-owners signed and the case has been forwarded for review.
owner.rejectedBody: The case has been sent back to the applicant. New confirmation links will be issued once they resubmit.

founder.title: Co-founder signature
founder.intro: {{applicant}} has submitted a registration for {{companyName}} that requires every co-founder's signature on the Articles of Association before it can be sent to the Business Register.
founder.consent: By approving you agree to found {{companyName}} with the share capital and management board above, under the attached Articles of Association.
founder.sentBody: All co-founders signed and the case has been forwarded for review.
founder.rejectedBody: The case has been sent back to the applicant. New signing links will be issued once they resubmit.
